# Genomic Biomarkers {#cpsr-biomarkers}

```{r bm_pdf_setup}
#| echo: false
#| eval: true

bm_pdf <- cps_report$content$snv_indel$callset$variant_display$biomarker
n_bm_items <- NROW(bm_pdf)
n_bm_variants <- if (n_bm_items > 0) length(unique(bm_pdf$VAR_ID)) else 0

## focused summary - evidence levels A/B, one row per variant, clinical
## significance and evidence source (therapies and cancer types collapsed;
## highest evidence level); ordered by evidence type (predictive first)
bm_summary_pdf <- data.frame()
n_bm_other_levels <- 0
if (n_bm_items > 0) {
  bm_levels_ab <- bm_pdf |>
    dplyr::filter(substr(.data$BM_EVIDENCE_LEVEL, 1, 1) %in% c("A", "B"))
  n_bm_other_levels <- n_bm_items - NROW(bm_levels_ab)
  if (NROW(bm_levels_ab) > 0) {
    ## variant identifier in the evidence source (CIViC variant id), for
    ## links to the source entry
    bm_raw <- cps_report$content$snv_indel$callset$variant$biomarker
    bm_levels_ab$BM_VARIANT_ID <- if (all(c(
      "BM_SOURCE_DB", "BM_EVIDENCE_ID", "BM_VARIANT_ID") %in% colnames(bm_raw)))
      as.character(bm_raw$BM_VARIANT_ID)[match(
        paste(bm_levels_ab$BM_SOURCE_DB, bm_levels_ab$BM_EVIDENCE_ID),
        paste(bm_raw$BM_SOURCE_DB, bm_raw$BM_EVIDENCE_ID))] else NA_character_
    bm_summary_pdf <- bm_levels_ab |>
      dplyr::mutate(
        EVIDENCE_TYPE_ORDER = match(
          .data$BM_EVIDENCE_TYPE,
          c("Predictive", "Prognostic", "Diagnostic", "Predisposing")),
        LEVEL = substr(.data$BM_EVIDENCE_LEVEL, 1, 1),
        VARIANT = stringr::str_replace(
          .data$SAMPLE_ALTERATION, paste0("^", .data$SYMBOL, " - "), ""),
        MATCH = dplyr::case_when(
          .data$BM_RESOLUTION == "genomic" ~ "variant",
          stringr::str_detect(.data$BM_RESOLUTION, "lof") ~ "gene (LoF)",
          TRUE ~ stringr::str_replace_all(.data$BM_RESOLUTION, "_", " ")),
        ## combination therapies, e.g. 'Cisplatin,Gemcitabine'
        THERAPY = stringr::str_replace_all(
          dplyr::coalesce(.data$BM_THERAPEUTIC_CONTEXT, ""), ",", " + ")) |>
      dplyr::group_by(
        .data$EVIDENCE_TYPE_ORDER, .data$SYMBOL, .data$VARIANT,
        .data$BM_CLINICAL_SIGNIFICANCE, .data$MATCH, .data$BM_SOURCE_DB) |>
      dplyr::summarise(
        ## source entry: the variant with the highest evidence level (then
        ## the most evidence items)
        ENTRY_ID = names(sort(table(
          .data$BM_VARIANT_ID[.data$LEVEL == min(.data$LEVEL)]),
          decreasing = TRUE))[1] %||% NA_character_,
        LEVEL = min(.data$LEVEL),
        THERAPIES = paste(sort(unique(.data$THERAPY[.data$THERAPY != ""])),
                          collapse = ", "),
        CANCER_TYPES = paste(sort(unique(.data$BM_CANCER_TYPE)),
                             collapse = ", "),
        .groups = "drop") |>
      dplyr::arrange(.data$EVIDENCE_TYPE_ORDER, .data$LEVEL, .data$SYMBOL)
  }
}
```

```{r bm_pdf_intro}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr NROW(bm_summary_pdf) > 0
cat(
  "The table below shows therapeutic, prognostic, diagnostic and ",
  "predisposing evidence items (from [CIViC](https://civicdb.org) ",
  "[@Griffith2017-do] and [CGI](https://www.cancergenomeinterpreter.org) ",
  "[@Dienstmann2015-od]) that are linked to pathogenic/ ",
  "likely pathogenic germline variants found in the sample. Evidence has been ",
  "aggregated and organized according to their strength (levels A/B) and clinical ",
  "significance. *Match* indicates whether the ",
  "evidence applies directly to the variant, or to a gene-level matching property ",
  "such as loss-of-function variants in the gene. Alterations are linked to ",
  "the corresponding entry of the evidence source (*Source*; CIViC variant, ",
  "or the CGI biomarker catalogue).\n\n", sep = "")
```

```{r bm_pdf_table}
#| echo: false
#| eval: !expr NROW(bm_summary_pdf) > 0

bm_summary_pdf |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    ENSEMBL_GENE_ID = cpsr:::gene_ensembl_id_pdf(cps_report, .data$SYMBOL),
    ENTRY_URL = cpsr:::bm_entry_url_pdf(.data$BM_SOURCE_DB, .data$ENTRY_ID)) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(
    c("SYMBOL", "VARIANT", "BM_CLINICAL_SIGNIFICANCE", "LEVEL", "CANCER_TYPES",
      "THERAPIES", "MATCH"), ~ dplyr::coalesce(as.character(.x), ""))) |>
  ## raw Typst markup (not escaped): gene as Open Targets link, alteration as
  ## link to the source entry (CIViC/CGI), clinical significance as colored
  ## pill and source as logo (as in the HTML report)
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gene = pcgrr::pdf_gene_link(.data$SYMBOL, .data$ENSEMBL_GENE_ID),
    Alteration = pcgrr::pdf_link(.data$VARIANT, .data$ENTRY_URL),
    `Clinical significance` = cpsr:::bm_significance_pill_pdf(
      .data$BM_CLINICAL_SIGNIFICANCE),
    Source = pcgrr::pdf_logo(
      .data$BM_SOURCE_DB, "1.4em", sources = c("civic", "cgi"))) |>
  dplyr::select(
    "Gene", "Alteration", "Clinical significance",
    Level = "LEVEL",
    `Cancer type(s)` = "CANCER_TYPES",
    Therapies = "THERAPIES",
    Match = "MATCH",
    "Source") |>
  tinytable::tt(width = c(0.7, 1.05, 1.9, 0.55, 2.05, 2.3, 0.8, 0.75)) |>
  tinytable::format_tt(j = 4:7, escape = TRUE) |>
  cpsr:::style_tt_header_pdf() |>
  tinytable::style_tt(j = 1, bold = TRUE)
```

```{r bm_pdf_legend}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr NROW(bm_summary_pdf) > 0
cat(pcgrr::pdf_legend(
  "bm_sources",
  sources = intersect(c("civic", "cgi"), bm_summary_pdf$BM_SOURCE_DB),
  muted = "cpsr-muted"))
```

```{r bm_pdf_no_ab}

  "for the Pathogenic/Likely Pathogenic variants.")))
```
